pages.title: A hotel lobby · 1/3
paragraphs: It is noon in a bright hotel lobby in Miami. Lia arrives from the airport with a big suitcase. Her flight was long and she feels a little tired. The hotel is white with blue windows. A clerk named Gus smiles behind the desk. She walks over with her passport.
“Hi! I have a reservation under Lia Costa.” says Lia. “Welcome! How many nights are you staying?” says Gus. “Three nights. What time is check-out?” says Lia.
